key.name: background
key.summary: What sits behind the windows on the canvas
key.description: wallpaper: your wallpaper, blurring and dimming as you zoom out. grid: a colour with a dot grid that pans and zooms with the canvas. colour: just the colour.

key.name: blur-on-zoom
key.summary: Blur and dim the wallpaper as you zoom out

key.name: show-grid
key.summary: Draw dots on the grid background

key.name: minimap-in-live-mode
key.summary: Show the minimap at 1:1, under your windows
key.description: Off by default: the minimap pops in only on the canvas, as in Sunlight 0.1.5

key.name: window-effect
key.summary: How windows open and close on the canvas
key.description: Automatic picks per window (Open Here grows from the spot, others sunrise). Reduce Animation in GNOME Settings makes every effect a fade.

key.name: dash-enter
key.summary: Enter apps opened from the canvas
key.description: On the canvas, picking an app from the dash, vertical app grid, or search opens it centred in the view and goes into it at 1:1. Off, the new window stays centred on the canvas. Dragging onto the canvas always places without entering. Running apps are always entered centred.

key.name: canvas-search
key.summary: What the canvas search bar finds
key.description: windows: find windows and frames (Return with none opens Open Here…). apps: an app launcher under the search bar. both: windows first, then apps (default).

key.name: canvas-app-grid
key.summary: Vertical app grid on the canvas
key.description: The dash grid button and a second three-finger swipe up open Skylight’s vertical scrolling app grid instead of GNOME’s overview apps view (faster; after gnome-vertical-app-grid). Off uses the overview.

key.name: remember-canvas
key.summary: Remember where windows are on the canvas between sessions

key.name: place-in-free-space
key.summary: Open new windows in free canvas space in view

key.name: follow-focus
key.summary: Glide to windows that get focus while partly off screen

key.name: replace-overview
key.summary: The canvas in place of the overview
key.description: Super, the Activities button, the hot corner and a three-finger swipe up show the canvas, with the dash and search; GNOME's overview stays for search and the app grid

key.name: four-finger-pan
key.summary: Four-finger swipe pans the canvas from anywhere
key.description: Three-finger swipes stay GNOME's (overview, dash, workspaces)

key.name: pinch-fingers
key.summary: Fingers needed to pinch-zoom from anywhere (two fingers work on the desktop and the canvas)

key.name: snapping
key.summary: Alignment guides while dragging (hold Ctrl to move freely)

key.name: drag-tile
key.description: Drop a window on a neighbour (diagonal halves) or toward the view's edges/corners to snap into Move & Resize slots. Hold Ctrl to move freely.

key.name: grid-size
key.summary: Drop grid, in pixels (0 turns it off)
key.description: A window let go on the canvas settles onto this grid, and windows side by side line up this far apart.

key.name: tile-gap
key.summary: Gap for Move & Resize and drag-to-tile, from the page's edges and between windows

key.name: tidy-style
key.summary: Tidy: a grid keeping sizes, or a tightly packed mosaic

key.name: tidy-order
key.summary: Tidy by where windows are, most recent first, or app

key.name: launcher
key.description: GNOME search (the overview, with files, settings and more) or Skylight's own app bar

key.name: strip-mode
key.description: Every window on one horizontal strip, a column per app, the app used last on the left

key.name: one-workspace
key.description: Turn GNOME's workspaces off and gather every window onto one canvas

key.name: saved-workspaces
key.summary: GNOME's workspace settings from before One workspace (internal)

key.name: launcher-recents
key.summary: Apps opened from Open Here…, most recent first (internal)

key.name: toggle-canvas
key.summary: See everything, and back into the window you came from

key.name: open-here
key.summary: Open Here…: pick an app to open where you're looking

key.name: strip-left
key.summary: Strip mode: the column on the left

key.name: strip-right
key.summary: Strip mode: the column on the right

key.name: strip-up
key.summary: Strip mode: the window above in the column

key.name: strip-down
key.summary: Strip mode: the window below in the column

key.name: tile-left-half
key.summary: Left half (again: two-thirds, then a third)

key.name: tile-right-half
key.summary: Right half (again: two-thirds, then a third)

key.name: tile-full
key.summary: Fill the screen (not maximised: it stays a canvas window)
